seller_feedback.feedback_text: H11SSL motherboard arrived in perfect working condition, new in box, exactly as described. Pricing is as good as I could find on ebay, and the package was shipped from China and arrived exactly one week later.
CPU works as described, well-packaged, shipping was slower than expected for paying an extra $35 but my expectations were set pre-US tariff conflict.

Excellent seller who expediently provided tracking information. Not only was it a great price but also the delivery time was also very good. Items arrived as described in the condition described. I would be confident in purchasing from them again.

Todo ok, llegó el paquete en dos o tres semanas a España. CPU En perfecto estado, limpio y funcional en una cajita con bolsita de pasta térmica como detalle incluido, aunque yo le puse la Artic mx7 recomendada.  Envío bien protegido; son CPUs reciclados pero se limpian, testean y someten a pruebas (según la IA). El seguimiento fue perfecto en su recorrido y con aviso de reparto. Servicio estupendo por parte del vendedor! ***** ...All ok, great service and on time tracking !!*****
Lightening fast delivery, well packaged, and as described. The items have great value and the prices are the best anywhere. I will shop here for more products routinely. Thank you.

Listed as new, but arrived loose/bubble-wrapped in a plain box with no OEM packaging. Board had bent pins and a damaged memory slot. Customs was also delayed due to incorrect shipment info. Seller accepted return, but this did not match a new motherboard buying experience.  Initial shipping and return and refund were very prompt.  My biggest issue is offering something as new that did not come as new.
One of the best sellers I've ever dealt with. This seller knows how to protect the product for shipment, excellently packaged and exactly as listed. Will happily deal with again.  10/10
Ordered a motherboard and cpu combo, showed up as described and in good condition. Everything was packed well and shipping was quick even from overseas.
